matches.title: I found some screenshots from my old (Now Deleted) account!!
matches.snippet: I found some screenshots from my old (Now Deleted) account!! All Screenshots date to Version "Smaller = Bigger" in 2020. Outlaw (Now Ranger) Stacking in Old Badlands. Molten Difficulty I remember I was helping some folks get Cowboy. Getting into a lobby with the Highest levelled Player at the time, we had practically the same loadout except for one tower (He Had DJ iirc while I had Pyro (I asked him what his loadout was)). This was when Level affected HP, so our base health was a whopping 1,331 HP. Yes, back then the highest level was 867, and that was already absurd as my at-the-time Level of 154 was in itself considered high. Triumph on the heights. Just a standard fallen game on a map i r
